falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate that analog's floor and invalidate the bottoming thesis, suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX elevation above 25 would indicate panic selling/forced deleveraging inconsistent with a bottom formation; the aug_2024 bottom featured VIX peaking then rapidly declining, so persistence above 25 breaks the pattern and signals distribution phase instead

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.75% and holds there for 2+ consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 42 suggests stress but not systemic panic; yields spiking above 4.75% would indicate a bond market revolt/liquidity event that overrides equity bottoming patterns, as the aug_2024 bottom occurred with yields stabilizing in the 3.8-4.2% range

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
